_description: Expected BSOD-safe settings for Windows VM templates/preferences. Consumed by bsod_template_checks.py and cnv-win-bsod-audit.sh Gates 17-19.
_windows_os_labels_note: L-21: reference list of os.template.kubevirt.io/<label> values seen on Red Hat Windows templates and preferences. Detection itself is done by windows_os_label_pattern (a PREFIX match on '/win'), NOT by membership in this list -- so an unlisted Windows label is still detected. The legacy Server 2008/2012/2012R2 entries were added because they dominate real MTV migration backlogs and their absence made the list read as an exhaustive set of supported guests, which it is not. win7/win81 were added for the same reason (legacy client-OS migration backlogs); winxp is deliberately NOT listed here because Red Hat's CNV/KubeVirt common-template catalog never shipped a Windows XP template (XP predates virtio-win/KubeVirt entirely) -- XP is only reachable via the name-fallback detection path (see CLAUDE.md's Windows-VM Detection section), not structured template/preference labels. test_template_checks.py asserts every entry matches the pattern.
